R228.note: Per-project role check is the right shape, but identity comes from a stub verifyBearerToken that accepts any 'Bearer <id>' string as the user, so a caller can name an owner ID and still delete; the placeholder, the new required token, and the assumed project_members table are all stated as follow-ups.

R229.note: Pins algorithms to RS256 on jwt.verify; nothing else changes.

R230.note: Named parameter with the wildcard wrapped into the bound value; query semantics, signature, and error propagation unchanged.

R231.note: redis-py RESP encoding closes the CRLF injection, but the function silently changes its return from the raw bytes reply to the client's bool, which the write-up does not mention.

R232.note: Moves Label into an attribute-encoded data-* and reads it via dataset; title, label, and numeric refreshSeconds all preserved per the stated contract, and the added attribute is stated.

R237.note: Injects IAntiforgery and calls ValidateRequestAsync before the sink with a 400 on failure; the new token requirement is inherent to the fix and stated.
